summary.text: Michele Meyer is a Democratic state representative from Maine House District 150 who is running for Maine State Senate District 35 in the November 3, 2026 general election; she is not seeking re-election to the House.
A nurse who lives in Eliot, she advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Michele Meyer lives in Eliot, Maine, and earned a B.S. in nursing from Norwich University in 1995.
Her career experience includes working as a nurse.
